title: Heat Check, Week 5
dek: Michael Wilson has 30 targets in two weeks. The stove's on in Arizona.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Wed 11:15 AM ET: rest-of-season ranks refreshed. Kyle Monangai climbs to RB29, Kyren Williams to RB12 and Brock Bowers to TE1; Omarion Hampton slips to RB14 and TreVeyon Henderson to RB26. Every call stands.

Heat Check is about direction, not box scores. A riser earned more of the ball week over week or got a new role you can see in the snap counts. A faller is losing snaps, routes or targets. One number backs each call, ranks are rest of season for me, and the scoring is PPR.
outro_md: Butcher Shop turns these trends into trade offers, and the Menu ranks every one of them for Week 5 on Wednesday.

risers.why: Wilson has 44 targets in four games, 30 of them in the last two, and caught 7 of 13 for 95 @NYG. He played 93 percent of the snaps in Week 3 while Marvin Harrison Jr. drew 9 targets all season.
risers.verdict: WR40 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench WR3.

risers.why: Williams caught 10 of 13 targets @PHI, a career high in catches, with 16 carries for 80 and 2 TDs. Blake Corum played 13 snaps, a breather and nothing more.
risers.verdict: RB12 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
risers.price: a WR3 and a bench RB

risers.why: McMillan ran a route on 92 percent of the dropbacks @CLE for 5 targets, then caught 14 of 16 for 192 and 2 TDs vs DET. Jalen Coker was inactive and Xavier Legette is on IR, so the targets have nowhere else to go.
risers.verdict: WR19 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the Week 5 bye; offer a WR2.

risers.stat: Targets 9 to 12; 39% of the targets in Week 4
risers.why: Tate ran a route on 92 percent of the dropbacks in Week 3 and drew 9 targets, then 12 @BAL for 9 catches and 145 yards. The rookie is the first read now.
risers.verdict: WR32 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench RB or a WR4.
risers.price: a bench RB or a WR4

risers.why: Likely's snap share rose three straight weeks, and vs ARI he drew 12 targets and caught 7 for 66. He has 35 targets in four games.
risers.verdict: TE11 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a TE in the 14 to 18 range and a bench piece.
risers.price: a TE in the 14 to 18 range and a bench piece

risers.stat: 13 and 11 targets, team highs both games back
risers.why: Bowers drew 13 of 30 targets in his first game back from knee surgery, then a team-high 11 vs KC with 6 for 86 and a TD. He has 16 catches for 202 and 2 TDs in two games.
risers.verdict: TE1 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2 and a TE in the 10 to 14 range.
risers.price: a WR2 and a TE in the 10 to 14 range

risers.why: Monangai ran 30 times for 146 and 2 TDs vs NYJ after D'Andre Swift fumbled in the third quarter and never came back. The thumb imaging was clean and Ben Johnson expects him to be fine @GB.
risers.verdict: RB29 rest of season for me. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: Snap share 25% to 38%; 15 touches to Hampton's 9 in Week 4
risers.why: Mitchell played 38 percent of the snaps in Week 3, then touched the ball 15 times @SEA with 10 carries for 39 and 5 catches for 24. He out-ran Omarion Hampton in routes 33 to 26 over the first three weeks.
risers.verdict: Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB. He holds half of the work vs DEN.

risers.stat: 28 of 61 snaps in Week 4, the last healthy back
risers.why: Shipley played 28 snaps vs LAR and finished as the only healthy back, and Tank Bigsby is on IR after core muscle surgery. Saquon Barkley is week to week, almost certainly out @JAX in London.
risers.verdict: Claim him, 10 to 15 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Boston played 61 snaps vs PIT and caught 4 of 7 for 89, Cleveland's leading receiver in three of four games. Jerry Jeudy had 5 targets in the first three.
risers.verdict: WR45 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench RB.

risers.why: Cooper played 90 percent of the snaps vs LAR and caught 3 for 33 and 2 TDs. DeVonta Smith is out two to three games, so the role holds @JAX.
risers.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Mayer caught 8 for 82 on 10 targets vs KC as Las Vegas ran two tight ends all day, next to Bowers' 11. One week of volume, so this is a TE-premium add.
risers.verdict: Add him in TE-premium leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

fallers.stat: Snap share 58%, 63%, 42%; 9 touches to Mitchell's 15 in Week 4
fallers.why: Hampton ran 9 times for 41 and a TD @SEA while Keaton Mitchell touched the ball 15 times. He has 3 targets all season.
fallers.verdict: RB14 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a top-15 RB who catches passes, or a WR2.
fallers.price: a top-15 RB who catches passes, or a WR2

fallers.stat: 15 carries, then the bench after a third-quarter fumble
fallers.why: Swift ran 15 times for 58 vs NYJ, lost a fumble at his own 28 in the third quarter and did not carry again while Kyle Monangai took 30. Monangai's thumb is expected to be fine for GB.
fallers.verdict: RB13 rest of season for me. Monitor the carry split @GB Sunday; a second game on the bench with Monangai healthy makes him a sell.

fallers.stat: 9 targets in three games, under 80% of the snaps each week
fallers.why: Harrison drew 4 targets on 62 routes in Weeks 1 and 2 and 5 in Week 3, while Michael Wilson drew 30 in the last two games. A national report put his trade value at possibly a quality Day 3 pick.
fallers.verdict: WR43 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR3 with a full-time role.
fallers.price: a bench WR3 with a full-time role

fallers.why: Downs caught 3 of 4 for 16 vs WAS in London with Alec Pierce on IR and Keenan Allen out, after 9 and 11 targets the two weeks before. His snap rate in two-tight-end sets fell to 50 percent in Week 3 from 88.6 before.
fallers.verdict: WR36 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets Sunday; another game under 5 makes him a sell.

fallers.why: Love ran 14 times for 63 @NYG after 21 carries on 64 percent of the snaps vs SF, and Tyler Allgeier scored on 8 carries. Mike LaFleur said Love tweaked his other ankle, and Love said the staff is managing his workload.
fallers.verdict: RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report before DET.

fallers.why: Dobbins played 42 percent of the snaps @SF and ran 11 times for 40 while RJ Harvey caught 10 passes. He has 46 carries for 161 in four games, 3.5 a carry.
fallers.verdict: RB36 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench RB with a clearer role.
fallers.price: a bench RB with a clearer role

fallers.why: Croskey-Merritt played 29 snaps vs IND and ran 9 times for 15, and Austin Ekeler took 17 snaps in his first game. Rachaad White (shoulder) is the third back when healthy.
fallers.verdict: RB31 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a role.
fallers.price: a bench WR with a role

fallers.why: Cook played a season-low 59.3 percent of the snaps vs NE, and Ty Johnson ran 15 routes on 19 snaps. Cook drew 1 target in Week 3, so the passing work is going elsewhere.
fallers.verdict: RB7 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share @LAR Monday night.

fallers.why: Henderson played 25 snaps to Rhamondre Stevenson's 35 @BUF and ran 14 times for 42 with no catch on 2 targets. Stevenson has out-snapped him two weeks running and took the score and the two-point try.
fallers.verdict: RB26 rest of season for me. Monitor the snap split vs LV Sunday.
fallers.watch: the snap split vs LV Sunday

fallers.stat: Nico Collins back at 69% of the snaps
fallers.why: Collins returned from the hamstring vs DAL and caught 7 for 118 and 2 TDs on 69 percent of the snaps. The targets Hutchinson saw in Weeks 2 and 3 go back to Collins.
fallers.verdict: Drop him for any add on the Market Run list.
